MORE ROOM TO ENJOY THE MOMENT

Do a little more.
Or a little less.

There’s no single way to spend a day at Mirror Lake. Find a quiet spot with a book, take a paddle across the water, or make an afternoon of games with your favorite people. Out here, you can follow your own rhythm.

A slower kind of lakeside afternoon.
BY THE WATER

Lake days.
Your way.

Cast a line, take in the view, or head out for a gentle paddle. The lake is the heart of the retreat—and a lovely place to simply be.

  • Kayaks, canoes, row boats & pedal boats
  • Fishing and quiet moments by the water
  • Time to read, relax, and reconnect
Explore lake activities →
A LITTLE FRESH AIR GOES A LONG WAY

Step outside.
See where the day goes.

From easygoing games to shared adventures, find something that brings everyone together.

TAKE THE SCENIC ROUTE

Hiking & fresh air

Explore our 200-acre property and its hiking trails. Take your time and enjoy the surroundings.

A LITTLE FRIENDLY COMPETITION

Games for all ages

Enjoy miniature golf, lawn games, and the Gaga Ball Pit. Make room for a little playful competition.

TRY SOMETHING TOGETHER

Shared adventures

Ask about add-on archery, the low ropes course, and rock climbing for your group.

Activities and equipment are subject to availability. Call 845-758-8764 for schedules, age requirements, and arrangements for your visit.

GATHER AROUND THE TABLE

Good food.
Even better company.
